content:
<thought>Generate a diverse list of oxide compositions (≤40). Retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition with max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, store them in a dedicated directory, list the resulting files, map each composition to its file, and consolidate all into a single JSON dataset. Finally, return the path to the consolidated file.</thought>
